mapper.sql: SELECT cf_id, cf_no, company_id, cost_date, period, source_module, source_type, source_id, material_id, material_code, qty, unit_cost, total_cost, target_type, target_key, voucher_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_cost_carry_forward
mapper.select: SELECT target_type AS targetType, SUM(qty) AS totalQty, SUM(total_cost) AS totalCost FROM fin_cost_carry_forward WHERE period = #{period} AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY target_type
